literal_meaning: গাল (অপমানজনক কথা) এর বর্ষণ বা পুনরাবৃত্তি
similar_in_english: give someone a piece of one's mind
example_sentences_in_bangla: দুজন প্রতিবেশী গালাগাল করে ঝগড়া শুরু করল।
সে তার ভাইকে গালমন্দ দিয়ে রাগ প্রকাশ করল।
example_sentences_in_english: The two neighbors started hurling abuses at each other and began fighting.
He expressed his anger by giving his brother a severe scolding.
note: These variants are synonymous and commonly used interchangeably in spoken Bengali to denote verbal reprimands.
